newsitem.title: BENIN: Yellow fever kills 37 children in Benin.
newsitem.headline: Yellow fever kills 37 children in Benin.

text.p: Yellow fever has killed 37 children in northwest Benin, medical officials said on Tuesday.
The outbreak, which begin at Kerou 550 km from the main city Cotonou in July, had resulted in 48 confirmed cases, they added.

Medicial officials blamed a lack of vaccination against the mosquito-borne disease. The dead were children up to the age of 15, they said. A vaccination programme has been launched and treated anti-mosquito nets provided.
